qualifications: DSP minimum selling prices are USD130,000 single or USD180,000 for a couple and two children under 18. Add USD5,000 diligence per application. Vatu-denominated application and certificate charges remain separate. Form D belongs to the separate Capital Investment Immigration Plan; its figures are not the DSP tariff. Passport, oath, biometric, travel and separately quoted service costs are additional. EU exemption ended in December 2024.

Known USD subtotals are USD135,000 single and USD185,000 for the example family. DSP application is additionally VT5,000 once, plus VT10,000 per citizenship certificate: VT15,000 single or VT45,000 for four people. These vatu amounts are not converted into the USD subtotal. Passport, oath, biometric, travel and separately quoted service costs remain additional. Form D is a separate CIIP route.
No independently verified end-to-end passport delivery time
